Part of the Ed"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"itTogether collection."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# EditApart — AI taste-driven editor (agent preset)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**EditApart** is an automation-faithful editor for the **EditTogether** community.
It takes raw foot"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"age, builds a shot inventory, proposes an **EDIT DECISION SCHEMA**
against a declared editorial rubr"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ic, renders it deterministically with
ffmpeg/scenedetect (and ImageMagick for photos), critiques the"},{"id":"p3s4","text":" render against the
rubric, and **revises** until it converges."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"It does **not** operate a video-editing GUI. It reasons about editorial judgment.
The plugin registe"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rs both video and photo tools plus the taste-model tools (15
total) under one identity; the engines "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"are `bin/edit_apart_core.py` (video),
`bin/photo_core.py` (photo) and `bin/taste_model.py` (the per-"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"part_core.py` (video),
`bin/photo_core.py` (photo) and `bin/taste_model.py` (the per-creator model)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## The core design"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Schema is the interlingua.** The same EDIT DECISION SCHEMA is the thing you
train on, the thing "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"you render from, and the thing you critique. No gap
between "AI intent" and "the render."
- **Genera"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"l grammar is shared; taste is per-creator.** One shared style-brain
(film-grammar parameters) + a sm"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"all per-creator identity latent `z_u` in a
per-creator GGUF. Only the identity is per-creator — the "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"artifact holds `z_u`
and a digest of the trunk it belongs to, nothing else.
- **Reward is dense + gr"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"oup-relative (GRPO).** The critic scores a render AND
yields per-element keep/drop/why deltas; `r = "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"overall + λ·Σ(deltas)`. Group
relative advantage `A_k = (r_k − mean(r))/std(r)`, then a PPO-clip ste"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"p.
- **Muon on weights, AdamW on the latent.** Muon orthogonalizes momentum for
2D weight matrices; "},{"id":"p6s9","text":"**never** the identity latent (Newton-Schulz degenerates
on 1D). AdamW handles `z_u` and all 1D/bias"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"/embed params.
- **Self-play interleaved with history.** `propose_schema` emits a *group* of
candida"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"te schemas from a deterministic grid; the group is logged, one candidate
is selected, and the render"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"/vision/creator outcome is logged back against it.
Training consumes those groups overnight.
- **Thr"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"ee model portions, and only one is the session model.** General (the
session model: reads footage, p"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"roposes, critiques) · FilmGPT style-brain
(shared film grammar) · creator taste (`z_u`). A video-in/"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"out model like
**GLM-5.3** (Z.ai / zai, OpenAI-compatible) replaces the **general portion
only** — i"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"t reads the raw clip via `{"type":"video_url","video_url":{"url":…}}`
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### The training datum (and why the raws are kept)"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A taste datum is not a timeline with a score; it is a **group**: alternatives produced
under one fix"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ed request, materials and constraint set. Schema **v3** of the group
record keeps everything a repla"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"y needs, in the record itself:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Kept | Why |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| `rubric` + `rubric_hash` | the constraints are what make the candidates comparable |
| `inventory`"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" + `inventory_hash` | the evidence the features were computed from (per-shot motion/luma/rms) |
| ea"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ch candidate's `schema` — the timeline, not just its knobs | so a feature can be re-derived, a rewar"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"d re-scored, and credit attributed to the effect that changed |
| `source_sha256` | the raws are ide"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ntified by **content**, not by path |
| `content_hash` | deterministic identity of the proposal, so "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"a ledger can key annotations to a revision |
| `selected`, `engine`, `feature_spec` | what was chose"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"n, by which build, under which layout |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Before v3 a record kept only derived numbers — no rubric, no inventory, no timeline, no
source ident"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ity — so a defect in the feature extractor or a change to the critic made
the corpus un-remeasurable"},{"id":"p11s3","text":". This project's own corrections log is a history of needing
exactly that: three conclusions flipped"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" after defects and each had to be re-measured
**on the same data**. Keeping the raws is the precondi"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"tion for that discipline, and an
NLE makes it sharper, because there the edit is a reference structu"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"re over a media pool
rather than a schema over one file."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"It recomputes each candidate's feature vector and the objective reward from the
recorded timeline + "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"inventory + rubric, verifies the hashes, and reports older records
as **not replayable** rather than"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" guessing. The subjective leg is a person's or agent's
judgment: it is reported as not recomputable "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"and never re-invented.
`tests/test_taste_model.py::TestLogReplay` is the acceptance test, with two n"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"egative
controls — a corrupted stored vector and a **changed source file** are both caught."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Why annotations stay on our side.** Measured: through the FCPXML adapter nothing of
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Trust & security"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **No shell command injection.** The engines launch processes with **list-argv**
`subprocess.run([."},{"id":"p16s2","text":"..])` and the plugins with `spawn(PY, [CORE, ...args])` —
never a shell string, never `shell=True`/`"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"os.system`. Paths and schema values
are passed as literal arguments, so a value like `x; rm -rf /` c"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"annot be
interpreted by a shell. The `;`-joined ffmpeg `filter_complex` string is a
single argv elem"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ent, not shell syntax.
- **Caption text is sanitized.** ImageMagick `-annotate`/`-caption`/`-label`
"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"interpret `%[...]`/`%[fx:...]` format escapes and a leading `@` as "read text
from file". The photo "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"engine escapes `%`/`@`/`\` to visually-identical
fullwidth codepoints (`_escape_annotate_text`) so u"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ntrusted caption text cannot
trigger an IM expression or file read — independent of the host ImageMa"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"gick
`policy.xml`. (The system package policy already disables `@` file-reads on
many images, but th"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"e code no longer relies on that.)
- **Paths are trusted tool args.** `src`, `out`, `outdir`, and gen"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"erated `asset`
paths are operator/model-supplied and passed straight to ffmpeg/scenedetect.
Within D"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"SH the sandbox scopes writes; if you run the engines **outside** DSH,
scope the process so a crafted"},{"id":"p16s13","text":" `out`/`outdir` cannot write outside your
intended directory.
- **`.dshenv` is a trust boundary.** T"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"he plugins load `<preset>/.dshenv` and set
`process.env` (only when the matching `DSH_*` env isn't a"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"lready set). Whoever
can write that file controls `DSH_EDIT_PY`/`DSH_SCENEDETECT`, hence the
execute"},{"id":"p16s16","text":"d interpreter. Keep it out of version control (it is gitignored) and
treat it as operator-owned."}],"truncated":true}
